pages.headline: Recovery is 18, well below your usual readiness level

pages.text:
Recovery is 18, well below your usual readiness level. Recovery 18% is in the red band. Resting heart rate up 17 bpm. HRV down 25 ms. Strain so far 19.3.

Your body is showing signs of low readiness, likely because the recent strain has pushed you beyond your usual threshold, with HRV dropping and heart rate rising against your baseline.

Begin with a quiet walk tonight, 20 minutes long, focusing on ease, to restore balance before bed, since the current dip in readiness suggests the load has exceeded your usual capacity.
